authorisation: owner, 2026-10-23: first operational recovery of Crawler's capabilities (tables and quantitative extraction)

areas.demonstrated_before: E6 equivalence on Crawler fixtures; V1 'reliable structure' on 11 spent HTML pages
areas.preserved: R-1 P0: through the Markdown-to-HTML adapter, 1F reads all 42 tables (2,078 cells) of three owner documents identically to markdown.py; no link occurs in their cells, so link preservation is untested on authentic material

areas.demonstrated_before: V1: 10 of 108 HTML statements reached only by 1G (product review tables)
areas.preserved: R-1 sealed run on Markdown scientific tables: 1G reads every table as record axes, assigns no property, adds evidence classes not supported by the text; 34 of 56 values found, 0 fully correct, 9 critical errors, 4 spurious

areas.demonstrated_before: X1/X2 measured the decision layer, not value reading
areas.preserved: R-1: on the sealed tables Pee's parser read every value 1G read with a unit (S: 38 values from Pee's parser, 0 from 1G only)

comparison.inputs: 10 sealed Markdown tables of the owner documents AP, DH, THREE-DH (spent), split by a mechanical rule; reference of 56 quantitative statements written by Claude before any arm ran
comparison.summary: old (O, Crawler 1G): 34 found, 0 fully correct, 9 critical; new (N, Pee): 6 found, 5 fully correct, 0 critical; selective (S): 38 found, 13 fully correct, 5 critical including a new type (wrong unit), 3 wrong answers after integration. Pre-registered rule D2/D5 fail and a stop condition is met.

justification: The pre-registered decision rule fails (D2, D5) and a stop condition is met, so S does not enter the operational path and no gated path changes. The ablation shows that S's gains over N come from Pee's own value parser applied to every cell, not from Crawler's code: no Crawler capability is shown to be recovered on this material. The tables where V1 found 1G's advantage (HTML product review tables) were not available in this session.
